First, note the date format is MM-DD-YYYY: 04-28-1599.  
Adding 183 days:  

April 28, 1599 + 183 days.  
April has 30 days, so from April 28: 2 days left in April → 30 - 28 = 2 days used.  
183 - 2 = 181 days left.  

May (31 days) → 181 - 31 = 150 left.  
June (30 days) → 150 - 30 = 120 left.  
July (31 days) → 120 - 31 = 89 left.  
August (31 days) → 89 - 31 = 58 left.  
September (30 days) → 58 - 30 = 28 left.  

October 28, 1599.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1599-10-28
